Punjab politician Ketan Agarwal's murder case takes a new turn

Ketan Agarwal, a Punjab politician, was found murdered in his office. The police are investigating the case and gathering evidence. The murder has raised concerns about the safety of politicians and the role of technology in crime investigation.
